description: This file serves as the entry point for the React application, importing core libraries, styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React DOM rendering process by creating a root element and rendering the App component within a StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to manage the React component tree for the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM element.
